title: Super Mario Party Jamboree - Mario Party Legacy

quotations.text: Start a unique event designed for that board and space.
Randomly receive bonus coins, an item, or a board specific benefit.
Randomly lose some of your coins, give coins to other players, or max out on Loadstones.
Activates Chance Time where coins and stars can be moved and swapped among players.
Each player chips in a select amount of coins, and a minigame is played
lose your coins, shuffle all players, equalize all coins, or even take a Star from you.
